<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

API mode runs the HTTP server and listener/resolver but not the signer. This mode requires a separate signer process and a shared message broker (NATS). Suitable for multi-instance deployments where the signer is isolated.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd serve api [flags] [args]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |
